name: Tamamo
source:
He is the fox spirit that is called the nine-tailed fox, and has very strong magical power.

Signing the contract with you, he shares his power with you. His tangible sensuality is dazzling to people. Even though his behaviors are wild, his mysterious charm makes it hard to hate him.

Organization: Kamakura Bakufu
Interests: Incense-matching game, teasing people
